title: PANs on hold, invalid or not available at the KRA (BSE UCC)
purpose: BSE UCC's lists of the firm's client PANs on hold, invalid, or not available at the KRA. None of the exchanges' or the depository's circulars gives the file's columns: they are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when the file's differs). The file is matched by PAN, then the client code.
linked: Matched with the clients on Compliance → KYC trading gate: each client on it is held back on the front ends until the KRA verifies the KYC and a later list no longer has the client.
source: BSE notice 20251111-43 and its monthly successors (latest 20261109-28), requirements 7-8. The columns are not published: read by header names.
